comment: P1 frontend performance budgets, gzipped bytes, enforced by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs in CI. Set with headroom above the current build; tighten as the bundle shrinks, never loosen silently. entryGraphGzip = shared JS every route loads (entry chunk + React/router vendor). landingFirstPaintGzip = bytes to paint '/' (entry graph + landing hero chunk; below-the-fold visuals are deferred and excluded). maxChunkGzip = ceiling for any single chunk (the React vendor chunk is the largest).
